annotations.title: Suggest fair returns for a trade

description: Given the players or picks on one side of a fantasy football trade, list fair returns for them: straight swaps, two-player packages, a player plus a pick, and picks only. Use for "what can I get for X?" or "what should I offer for X?".

assets.description: The side of the trade that is already decided: what the user would give up (or wants to acquire). Each entry is a player name ("Ja'Marr Chase") or a rookie draft pick: "2027 1st" (add early, mid or late if known, e.g. "early 2027 1st") or an exact slot "2027 1.03"

league.description: League settings. Omit for the default: 12-team dynasty Superflex, full PPR, 1 QB / 2 RB / 3 WR / 1 TE / 1 Flex (+1 Superflex)

format.description: dynasty (keeper, multi-year value) or redraft (rest of this season only)

ppr.description: Points per reception: 1 full PPR, 0.5 half, 0 standard

superflex.description: True if teams can start a second quarterback (Superflex or 2QB). Default: true for dynasty, false for redraft

te_premium.description: Extra points per tight end reception

name: suggest_fair_trade_returns
